summary: Iteration 19: Verified new Services build-out (business-strategy / ma-advisory / fund-raising with signature flag), 13-tool Strategy Toolkit, 6 Strategy Insights, PDF generation, and frontend integration. Backend: 14/14 pytest passed. integration_issues.issue: hCaptcha uses production sitekey (73c8f63e-...) rather than the hCaptcha test sitekey (10000000-ffff-ffff-ffff-000000000001). Review request said preview auto-passes; in reality a user click on the hCaptcha checkbox is still required. Not a blocker — modal, email input and submit button all wire correctly to /api/nurture/subscribe. Full end-to-end submit cannot be automated in headless Playwright without solving captcha.

action_items: Optional: switch REACT_APP_HCAPTCHA_SITEKEY to the hCaptcha test sitekey (10000000-ffff-ffff-ffff-000000000001) on the preview host so the tool-download flow can be end-to-end automated. Current behavior is otherwise correct.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is >5800 lines — should be split into routers (services, strategy, deals, etc). Not blocking iteration 19 but growing risk.
server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event startup/shutdown — migrate to FastAPI lifespan handlers.
Route ordering in server.py correctly places /strategy-tools/{slug}.pdf before /strategy-tools/{slug} — verified working (Ansoff & Fishbone PDFs both return valid %PDF).
